Discover the situation

Describing your home

People often need to talk about their home — with a neighbour, a new friend, or on a form. In this activity, you will discover the English used to describe a home.

You will meet the words and phrases people use to describe a house or apartment, its rooms, and what is nearby.

Useful words for this situation

Tap a card to see what each word means.

Discover the situation

See how people use this English

Read this short exchange between two neighbours.

A

What is your home like?

B

I live in an apartment. My apartment has two bedrooms.

A

What is the kitchen like?

B

The kitchen is small. I need a quiet place.

A

Is there a shop near your home?

B

Yes. There is a supermarket near my home.

What is happening?

Look at the exchange again and think about these questions. There are no wrong answers — explore at your own pace.
